source: raw/books/From nucleons to nucleus concepts of microscopic .pdf
reading_status: bounded equation-to-code audit; not full-chapter completion
audited_content: BCS quasiparticle energy and occupation amplitudes

implementation.method: finite-space constant monopole pairing with bisection lambda and damped gap iteration
explicit_boundaries: average particle number rather than exact number projection
positive u/v phase and gap magnitude
no SDI orbital self-energy, LN projection, blocking, deformation or cranking

evidence_boundary: The implementation is a reusable numerical baseline derived from the checked BCS equations. It is not a claim that the full Suhonen chapter, SDI self-energy, Lipkin-Nogami extension, or A~130 triaxial pairing problem has been completed.
